description: Get posts from a REDDIT subreddit — r/LocalLLaMA, r/python, r/news. PREFER for "what are people posting in r/<sub>", "whats new on r/<sub> today", "top posts on Reddit this week". Sorted hot (default), new, top, rising, or controversial. For "top"/"controversial" pass a time window (day/week/month/year/all) — e.g. "top posts in r/programming this week". Returns post id, title, author, permalink, date, and a body snippet. (Vote score and comment count are not available via Reddit RSS.)

time.description: For sort=top/controversial: hour, day, week, month, year, all (default day).

name: get_subreddit
